en: The image is a multi-view postcard with a red border, featuring four main images: (1) a large domed building with a distinctly Ottoman architectural style, likely a mosque, situated in a city square with cars and people; (2) a smaller domed structure with a minaret, also suggestive of Ottoman influence; (3) a large Romanesque cathedral with four towers and a statue in front; (4) stone ruins in a park-like setting. There is an emblem or coat of arms in the center featuring a red star. There is no visible text identifying the locations.
